summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Catalog Browsing & Search (Menu page + Admin Menu & Search configuration). Backend: 20/20 tests pass covering GET /api/catalog/settings (public), GET/PATCH /api/admin/catalog/settings (auth, partial PATCH, invalid-sort 400, dietary-tag whitelist enforcement, quick_view propagation), and /api/search/menu (text, dietary single + multi $all, price range, in_stock_only, sort asc/desc/name/invalid-fallback, limit cap). Seed backfill: items 001-010 all carry dietary_tags. Frontend: MenuPage renders menu-toolbar, menu-search-input, menu-sort-select, open-filters-btn, sticky-category-bar with 4 category pills + 4 sections, autocomplete-dropdown with autocomplete-{id} entries, filter-drawer with 6 dietary chips + price-slider + in-stock-switch, active-filter-count badge + active-chips-row + chips-clear-all, no-results-state with 6 search-suggest-* chips (click fills input), quick-view-modal opens on card click, quickview-qty-plus/minus + quickview-add-btn add-to-cart closes modal. Admin /admin/catalog-settings page saves settings; default_sort=price_asc reflects on /menu; quick_view_enabled=false causes card click to route to /product/:id (verified item-010). Defaults fully restored at end.

issues: Radix Dialog emits 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' console warning — add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby for a11y compliance

action_items: TESTID NAMING MISMATCH (non-blocking): review_request spec lists admin testids as 'admin-default-sort', 'admin-price-min', 'admin-price-max', 'admin-quick-view-switch', 'admin-sticky-bar-switch', 'admin-in-stock-switch', 'admin-catalog-save', 'admin-dietary-*', but AdminCatalogSettings.js uses 'default-sort-select', 'price-min-input', 'price-max-input', 'quick-view-switch', 'sticky-bar-switch', 'in-stock-toggle-switch', 'catalog-save-btn', 'dietary-toggle-*'. Functional behaviour is correct, but rename testids to match the published contract for downstream regression stability.
Add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to QuickViewModal and FilterDrawer DialogContent to silence a11y console warnings.

Unrelated pre-existing failure (NOT caused by this feature): test_menu_catalog.py::test_get_sold_out_item and test_get_seasonal_item fail because item-007 and item-003 currently report status='in_stock' in DB — earlier seeds expected 'sold_out'/'seasonal'. Seed must enforce statuses, or tests should be updated.
critical_code_review_comments: catalog_settings.py _get_catalog_settings() correctly merges defaults with persisted doc, supports upsert on PATCH — good pattern.
PATCH endpoint properly enforces sort whitelist (400) and filters dietary_tags against ALL_DIETARY_TAGS — good defensive input handling.

search.py applies $all on dietary[] and regex-escapes q — safe against injection. Popularity sort relies on popularity_score field; if absent the sort still works (Mongo treats missing as null, newer first via created_at tiebreak).
MenuPage.js triggers a settings fetch + grouped re-render but useEffect dep list for items fetch doesn't include `sort` explicitly — wait, it DOES; verified.
AdminCatalogSettings.js uses explicit data-testid values that diverge from the review spec — rename for contract alignment (see action_items).
Minor: FilterDrawer uses shadcn Sheet without DialogDescription; a11y warning. Same for QuickViewModal.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of scripted flows; all critical testids present on /menu; admin page functional with actual (non-spec) testids

seed_data_creation: None. All mutations rolled back: catalog_settings restored to defaults (visible_dietary_tags=vegan/vegetarian/gluten_free/halal/nut_free/spicy, default_sort=popularity, quick_view_enabled=true, price_min=0, price_max=100, sticky_category_bar=true, show_in_stock_toggle=true) via PATCH teardown fixture + explicit UI restore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints live: /api/catalog/settings (public) and /api/admin/catalog/settings (admin, require Bearer or cookie). Admin UI at /admin/catalog-settings. The review_request mentions testids prefixed admin-* on AdminCatalogSettings, but actual implementation uses: default-sort-select, price-min-input, price-max-input, quick-view-switch, sticky-bar-switch, in-stock-toggle-switch, catalog-save-btn, dietary-toggle-{tag}. Save button is catalog-save-btn (not admin-catalog-save). Reset is catalog-reset-btn. Use these in any next regression until renamed. Pre-existing unrelated failures in test_menu_catalog.py for item-007 (expects sold_out) and item-003 (expects seasonal).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works end-to-end. Only concern is a testid naming contract mismatch which is cosmetic for downstream test stability.
